items.title: 16.2.8 Other Endocrine Glands/Tissues (printed '16.2.8.' with trailing dot) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of other endocrine glands and tissues (PDF 68-69).

blocks.text: Endocrine system mein kai aur glands bhi hain. Is ke ilawa dimagh, meday (stomach), chhoti aant, jigar aur doosre organs mein bhi khaas endocrine cells hote hain.

items: Thymus gland sternum (seene ki haddi) ke neeche aur dono phephron ke darmiyan hota hai. Yeh thymosin hormone chhorta hai jo T cells ko pukhta (mature) karta hai; T cells jism ko pathogens (bimari phailane wale jaraseem) se bachate hain.
Pineal gland dimagh ki tah (base) ke qareeb hota hai (kitab ke alfaaz). Yeh melatonin hormone chhorta hai jo neend ke andaz (sleep patterns) qaboo karta hai.

Kuch hazme ke aaza ki deewaron ke endocrine cells bhi hormones chhorte hain jo hazme ke amal qaboo karte hain. Maslan khana khane par meday ki deewar ke endocrine cells gastrin hormone chhorte hain jo gastric glands se gastric juice chhurwata hai. Chhoti aant ki deewar ke endocrine cells secretin hormone chhorte hain jo pancreas se pancreatic juice chhurwata hai. Chhoti aant ki deewar cholecystokinin hormone bhi chhorti hai jo gallbladder (pitta) se bile chhurwata hai.

Gurde renin hormone banate hain jo adrenal glands mein aldosterone ki paidawar qaboo karta hai. Gurde erythropoietin hormone bhi banate hain jo bone marrow (haddi ka gooda) se RBCs (surkh khooni cells) banwata hai. Gurdon ka ek aur hormone, calcitriol, aant se calcium jazb karwa kar khoon ka calcium barhata hai.
Dimagh endorphins naam ke hormones banata hai. Endorphins dard ke receptors se jur kar dard ka ehsas rok dete hain.

Prostaglandins hormone jaise maadde hain jo jism ke taqreeban tamam cells banate hain. Yeh taqatwar, maqami (local) taur par asar karne wale vasodilators (khoon ki nalyan phailane wale) hain aur inflammation (sozish) mein hissa lete hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: seene ke aaza saamne se: oopar trachea (saans ki nali) aur bari khoon ki nalyan, do taraf phephre aur neeche dil; do lobes wala thymus gland phephron ke darmiyan dil ke oopar hai. Daen: dimagh beech se kata hua; pineal gland markaz mein gehrai mein, ventricle ke peeche aur cerebellum ke oopar aik chhota sa hissa hai.

blocks.text: Baen taraf seene ke aaza saamne se dikhaye gaye hain: dono phephron ke darmiyan aur dil ke oopar do lobes wala thymus gland. Daen taraf dimagh ko beech se kata hua dikhaya gaya hai: pineal gland ek chhota sa hissa hai jo dimagh ke andar gehrai mein, cerebellum ke oopar, hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Gurde kaunse teen hormones banate hain, aur har ek ka kaam kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Renin: adrenal glands mein aldosterone ki paidawar qaboo karta hai. Erythropoietin: bone marrow se RBCs banwata hai. Calcitriol: aant se calcium jazb karwa kar khoon ka calcium barhata hai.

items: Thymus (thymosin, T cells ki pukhtagi) aur pineal gland (melatonin, neend).
Hazme ke hormones: gastrin (meda), secretin aur cholecystokinin (chhoti aant).
Gurde: renin, erythropoietin, calcitriol; dimagh: endorphins; taqreeban tamam cells: prostaglandins.
